panels.title: HEBBAL GENERAL · 13:10
panels.text: The strip in your pocket. You don't run until the gate.

panels.title: OLD MADRAS ROAD · 16:30
panels.text: On a shutter, in paint: WE ARE INSIDE. Under it, later, in another hand: NOT ANYMORE.

panels.title: AMBEDKAR NAGAR · 18:40
panels.text: The purple light is still on.
